newsitem.title: UK: FORECAST-Vickers yr profits to nudge ahead.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Vickers yr profits to nudge ahead.

text.p: Year profits at defence to Rolls-Royce car maker Vickers Plc are expected to edge forward on Wednesday to around 83.5 million stg, say analysts, compared with 75 million last year.
The profit forecasts range between 82 million and 85 million, with the dividend expected to be pitched at a consensus 7.5 pence per share. Earnings per share is seen at around 16.8 pence per share.
Analysts said they expected the group to be hampered by the big investment costs into a new Rolls Royce motor car and the Cosworth unit.
Capital expenditure is seen remaining at a high level, with negative group cash flow.
The Rolls Royce unit is expected to deliver modest growth. In early January, the group said world sales of Rolls Royce and Bentley cars was up 12 percent in 1996 on the previous year.
Elsewhere, the automotive business is seen remaining flat, said Zafar Khan, analyst at SocGen who is forecasting profits of 85 million stg. Defence profits are seen being restrained.
The strong level of sterling is unlikely to have too damaging an impact on the results, said analysts, with currency hedging already likely to be in place.
